summary: ```# Connect Store Pipeline Tutorial Welcome to the tutorial on the Connect Store Pipeline. In this tutorial, you will learn how to easily adapt and create a downloaded asset. ## Accessing the Connect Store First, type "Connect" into the search bar. This will take you to the Connect home page. Once you're in the store, you'll see a lot of items. From the Connect official page, you can download a free item that you can apply directly to your default avatar in Marvelous Designer. - Block FV2 is the default female avatar in Marvelous Designer. - Block MV2 is ready to use on the default male avatar in Marvelous Designer. You can click "Show All" on Block FV2 to see more items. Select the items you want, and click the "Add to Cart" button to add them to your cart. Once you've added everything to your cart, check the price and download the assets. ## Extracting and Loading Assets Extract the downloaded asset folder. Load the female avatar you want in Marvelous Designer. We will hide the library window so that you can see the screen better. You can load it via the main menu: **File → Open → Garment** or you can immediately drag and drop the unzipped file to load it. - Click "Yes" if you want to load the poses contained in the file as they are. - If you want to keep the current pose, click "No" to load the garment. I’m going to click "No" to keep my current pose. ## Fitting the Garment In the 2D pattern window, select the auto-fit icon to automatically fit the garment to the size of the avatar. Please refer to the manual for more information. In the 3D window, you'll see if your avatar is properly dressed. Right-click in the 2D pattern window, click "Optimize All Curve Points," and reduce the curve points. We will use the Edit Pattern tool to modify the shape of the pattern. Modify the pattern shape of the shoulder lines and armholes. Press the keyboard space bar to simulate it and see it in the 3D window. ## Creating the Sleeve Pattern To create the sleeve pattern, we will use the Rectangle tool to create a rectangular pattern of the desired size. Use the Free Sewing tool to attach the pattern. At this point, select one segment line and press "Shift" to sew multiple patterns on one pattern. Press the space bar on your 3D pattern to create a 3D view. Feel free to modify the sleeve pattern to your liking. You can see how your sleeve pattern will look in the 3D window and modify it accordingly. ## Adjusting the Skirt Length In the 3D window, use the Move Styline tool to lengthen the skirt. This action can be repeated as needed to achieve the desired length. ## Applying Fabrics and Adjustments Open the Fabric tab in the Library window. Choose from a variety of fabrics and drag your favorite fabric to the Fabric window to apply it. For example, I searched for silk and applied silk charmeuse. Once the fabric is selected, you can adjust various options in the Property Editor window to make changes to the garment. I’ll change the color. Select the whole pattern with the Transform Pattern tool to decrease the value of particle distance. Simulate to see the wrinkle quality of the garment in the 3D window. ## Exporting Finished Garments You can export your finished garments to the Unreal Engine through the main menu: **Help → Marvelous Designer Live Sync**. Please refer to the Live Sync Manual for more information. You can also export your finished garment and print it on the Fabric window in the Arm Empress web browser. - Click on the "Show More" button to update the versions. - Click on the "Render" button to create a new version of your oracle. - Click on the "Builder" to install the oracle. - Click on the "Download" button to install the new version of the oracle. - Click on the button to activate the Oracle. ```
